name: SBI PO Prelims Full Mock Test - Practice Test 2
courseName: SBI PO Prelims Full Mock Test

questions.question: Which bank is the largest public sector bank in India?
questions.hint: State Bank of India is the largest public sector commercial bank in India.

questions.question: What is the full form of RTGS?
questions.hint: RTGS stands for Real Time Gross Settlement.

questions.question: Who acts as the lender of last resort in India?
questions.hint: The Reserve Bank of India acts as the lender of last resort for commercial banks.

questions.question: What is the minimum age required to open a bank account independently?
questions.hint: Under RBI guidelines, minors above 10 years can open and operate accounts independently.

questions.question: The term "Bull" and "Bear" are associated with:
questions.hint: Bull and Bear describe upward and downward stock market trends respectively.

questions.question: Who is the current executive head of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI)?
questions.hint: The RBI is headed by its Governor.

questions.question: Who introduced the Banking Ombudsman Scheme in India?
questions.hint: The RBI first introduced the Banking Ombudsman Scheme in 1995 to resolve customer complaints.

questions.question: Where is the central headquarters of the Reserve Bank of India located?
questions.hint: The RBI central office was established in Kolkata but permanently moved to Mumbai in 1937.

questions.question: What does PIN stand for in debit/credit card transactions?
questions.hint: PIN stands for Personal Identification Number.

questions.question: What is the validity period of a bank cheque in India from the date of issue?
questions.hint: Cheques are valid for 3 months from the date written on them.

questions.question: Under which system does the RBI issue currency notes in India?
questions.hint: RBI adopted the Minimum Reserve System in 1957, requiring it to keep minimum reserves of Rs 200 crore.

questions.question: Whose signature is present on the one-rupee currency note in India?
questions.hint: The One Rupee note is issued by the Ministry of Finance and signed by the Finance Secretary.

questions.question: How many members constitute the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) of India?
questions.hint: The MPC consists of 6 members: 3 from RBI and 3 external members appointed by the Government.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a Negotiable Instrument under the Negotiable Instruments Act?
questions.hint: Share certificates are not negotiable instruments.

questions.question: What is the primary source of profits for commercial banks?
options: Difference between interest charged on loans and paid on deposits
questions.hint: The spread (interest margin) is the core profit source for banks.
